source_grouping_policy: The 27 source events will be partitioned into three disjoint groups (A, B, C) of 9 events each during RST1. No grouping or fold assignment is performed in RST0.
permitted_uses_for_source_labels: Supervised source model training on declared training partition events.
Computing class distribution statistics strictly from declared training partition events.
Evaluating event-disjoint validation/discovery performance on held-out source partition events.
Computing confirmatory evaluation metrics on held-out source partition events after recipe freeze.
prohibited_uses_for_historical_target_da: Method development, component selection, loss function selection, or augmentation selection.
Epoch budget determination, learning rate schedule tuning, or optimizer tuning.
Checkpoint selection, early stopping decisions, or promotion decisions.
Loading or inspecting image rasters or ground-truth masks prior to RST9.

fail_closed_behavior.description: Any loader, trainer, or evaluator encountering an undeclared event ID, overlapping partitions, or an event in forbidden_before_rst9 prior to RST9 must immediately fail closed with an explicit exception.
